info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Case Management API
info.description: The Card Case Management API enables financial institutions to efficiently update and manage card case details associated with customer banking services. By utilizing this API, organizations can amend the status, details, or attributes of specific card cases identified by a unique parameter. This service is particularly beneficial for customer service teams and developers building systems for card servicing solutions. Through effective use of this API, businesses can enhance customer experiences and streamline operational processes related to card management.

put.summary: Update the details of a specific card case.
put.description: This operation allows you to update the information related to a specific card case identified by CARD-400045. Ensure that all required fields are populated correctly to avoid errors during the update process.
